subject: Physics
subtopic: Applied friction, connected systems and momentum-rate extensions
axis_note: Owner-approved external-question-demand matrix. It supplements rather than replaces MATRIX-PHY-NLM-FIRST-LAW and does not make these microtopics school-issued by default.

controlled_variation.notice: actual static friction changes while mu_sN remains only the ceiling
normal reaction and friction scale can change

must_contain: At least two separate FBD equations.
A derived or geometry-appropriate acceleration constraint.

controlled_variation.notice: common acceleration and tension change through coupled equations
acceleration relation must be re-derived rather than memorized

must_contain: A momentum change for one chosen body/item.
A time interval or item rate converting momentum to average force.
A Newton-III body check for recoil when relevant.

controlled_variation.notice: average force scales linearly with rate
average force changes inversely with interval

family.invariant_demand: Choose body/contact/connection/interval first, state model assumptions, write the local force or momentum relation, and verify state/constraint consistency.
family.difficult_move: Avoiding automatic formulas: muN is not always actual friction, tension equality is conditional, and momentum becomes force only through time/rate.
family.independent_check: Static friction must satisfy its bound; connected-body solutions satisfy every body equation/string constraint; momentum-rate results have force units and correct reaction-body ownership.

support_ladder.handed_over: Contact state, body boundaries and connection assumptions are named.
Body boundaries and geometry are supplied; learner chooses relations.
Only setup and requested quantity are supplied.

transfer.changed_demand: A coefficient is given but learner must decide below-limit, limiting or sliding state.
An incline or multi-block story requires normal/friction equations from existing FBD/vector capabilities.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: which component determines N and which contact is limiting

transfer.changed_demand: Several bodies and an ideal connection require separate equations linked by a constraint.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: force ownership and allowed connection equalities

transfer.changed_demand: Repeated-emission story gives mass, speed and items/s without naming momentum rate.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: conversion from per-item momentum to per-time transfer
